authority: Amendment 2026-10-03 (K1), megareview rulings (4); publication ruling D147 (a), 2026-10-03
note: Counts, dates and digests of the T-COST answers held in data/raw/thetadata; no vendor row and no figure derived from one. first_id and last_id bound the depot ids of the answers read, which need not be contiguous; answers_sha256 = one digest over their body_sha256 values, in request order. figures_sha256 = the sha256 of the figures file at figures_path, which no bundle prefix reads. A used quote or trade entered a figure; a dropped one had a zero bid, a crossed or locked quote, or no quote.
